mapper.sql: select o.order_id, o.version, o.order_no, o.order_title, o.customer_id, o.customer_name, shop_dept.dept_name as target_dept_name, coalesce(detail_summary.total_quantity, 0) as total_quantity, coalesce(detail_summary.delivered_quantity, 0) as delivered_quantity, coalesce(detail_summary.remaining_quantity, 0) as remaining_quantity, o.total_amount, o.order_date, o.status, o.shop_dept_id, o.applicant_id, o.applicant_name, u.nick_name as applicant_nick_name, o.applicant_dept_id, applicant_dept.dept_name as applicant_dept_name, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark from inv_sales_order o left join sys_dept shop_dept on shop_dept.dept_id = o.shop_dept_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = o.applicant_id left join sys_dept applicant_dept on applicant_dept.dept_id = o.applicant_dept_id left join ( select order_id, sum(coalesce(quantity, 0)) as total_quantity, sum(coalesce(delivered_quantity, 0)) as delivered_quantity, sum(coalesce(quantity, 0) - coalesce(delivered_quantity, 0)) as remaining_quantity from inv_sales_detail group by order_id ) detail_summary on detail_summary.order_id = o.order_id
mapper.select: select order_id, version, order_no, order_title, customer_id, customer_name, total_amount, order_date, status, shop_dept_id, applicant_id, applicant_name, applicant_dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from inv_sales_order where order_id = #{orderId} for update

where o.shop_dept_id = #{shopDeptId} and o.status not in ('draft', 'cancelled')
and (locate(#{query.keyword}, o.order_no) > 0 or locate(#{query.keyword}, o.customer_name) > 0)
and locate(#{query.orderNo}, o.order_no) > 0 and locate(#{query.customerName}, o.customer_name) > 0 and o.order_date >= #{query.startDate} and o.order_date <= #{query.endDate} and exists ( select 1 from inv_sales_detail sd where sd.order_id = o.order_id and coalesce(nullif(sd.item_type, ''), 'product') in ('product', 'gift') and coalesce(sd.item_id, sd.product_id) is not null and coalesce(sd.delivered_quantity, 0) > ( select coalesce(sum(rd.quantity), 0) from inv_sales_return_detail rd inner join inv_sales_return r on r.return_id = rd.return_id where r.sales_order_id = o.order_id and r.status in ('submitted', 'returned') and (rd.sales_detail_id = sd.detail_id or (rd.sales_detail_id is null and coalesce(nullif(rd.item_type, ''), 'product') = coalesce(nullif(sd.item_type, ''), 'product') and coalesce(rd.item_id, rd.product_id) = coalesce(sd.item_id, sd.product_id))) ) and ( select coalesce(sum(same_item.delivered_quantity), 0) from inv_sales_detail same_item where same_item.order_id = o.order_id and coalesce(nullif(same_item.item_type, ''), 'product') = coalesce(nullif(sd.item_type, ''), 'product') and coalesce(same_item.item_id, same_item.product_id) = coalesce(sd.item_id, sd.product_id) ) > ( select coalesce(sum(rd.quantity), 0) from inv_sales_return_detail rd inner join inv_sales_return r on r.return_id = rd.return_id where r.sales_order_id = o.order_id and r.status in ('submitted', 'returned') and coalesce(nullif(rd.item_type, ''), 'product') = coalesce(nullif(sd.item_type, ''), 'product') and coalesce(rd.item_id, rd.product_id) = coalesce(sd.item_id, sd.product_id) ) ) order by o.create_time desc, o.order_id desc

delete from inv_sales_order where order_id in
#{orderId}
